key_findings.z60_field_dependent: CRITICAL: z60 effect is FIELD-DEPENDENT. z60 BOOSTS 2Y for direct neg fields (conf_low 0.07->0.39, neg_max 0.26->0.93) but HURTS 2Y for flipped std fields (pos_std 0.78->0.30, neut_std 0.45->-0.07). Direct neg signals improve over time (z60 captures trend), flipped std signals are recent-concentrated (z60 dilutes).
